license_evidence: LICENSE.md (blob ab79d16a3f4c6c894c028d1f7431811e8711b42b) is the three-clause BSD text: retain notice, reproduce notice, no endorsement
runtime_decision: never a runtime dependency; ECDEV's redirect decision is native (adapter/web/src/lib.rs::redirect_target)

oracle.generator: embedded in the fixture (generator_source); reads the unmodified donor models in memory, no network
oracle.agreement: 650 of 650 cases where both httpx and ECDEV follow produce the same target (fragment removed, WHATWG serialization); 975 non-redirect cases agree

deliberate_divergences.public_url_policy: 75 cases: httpx follows ftp://, userinfo and ?token= targets; ECDEV holds every redirect target to the requested-URL policy (normalize_url)
deliberate_divergences.refused_instead_of_guessed: 150 cases: //, ///triple, backslashes, a host with a space, http:/nohost, port 99999; httpx guesses a target, WHATWG would resolve some to a different host, ECDEV returns INVALID_REDIRECT
deliberate_divergences.fragment: httpx re-attaches the previous fragment (RFC 7231 7.1.2); ECDEV URL identity carries no fragment
deliberate_divergences.limit: httpx follows up to 20 redirects; ECDEV at most 5, with loop detection, inside its fetch budget

defects_found_in_ecdev: redirect targets bypassed normalize_url: credentials, credential queries, fragments and non-http schemes were followed
every 3xx with a Location was followed (300, 305, 306); only 301, 302, 303, 307 and 308 redirect
cache validators were sent to every redirect hop; a 304 from another resource would have reused the prior payload

capabilities.httpx.redirect-request-rewriting: NOT_ADOPTED; STUDY_COMPLETE[DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE]: the study found ECDEV sent the previous capture's If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since to every redirect hop, so a 304 from a different resource would reuse a payload it never captured. Validators now go only to the URL that produced them (validators_for; regression adapter/web/src/lib.rs::validators_go_only_to_the_url_that_produced_them), legacy validators without a URL only to the requested URL, and an unsolicited 304 is refused (UNSOLICITED_NOT_MODIFIED). httpx keeps validators across redirects and strips only Authorization
capabilities.httpx.content-decoding: NOT_ADOPTED; STUDY_CANDIDATE: content-encoding and charset fallback (httpx decoders, autodetect) versus ECDEV's document decoder on pages without a declared charset
capabilities.httpx.transport-and-pooling: NOT_ADOPTED; REFERENCE_ONLY: httpcore pooling, HTTP/2 and proxy routing as a reference for a higher-throughput crawler
capabilities.httpx.auth-and-cookies: NOT_ADOPTED; DELIBERATE_SEMANTIC_DIVERGENCE: ECDEV public research fetches carry no credentials or cookies
